content.text:
Background (from the session that started this one):
AMU (PyPI name `anti-messup`, command `amu`, repo github.com/abslock128w/AMU, git remote named `github`, `gh` authenticated as abslock128w) posts one comment per pull request from a two-workflow GitHub Action (`evaluation/ci/INSTALL-NOTE.md`): it runs tests on the merge base and the head, reports flips (confirmed by rerun), change evidence (the PR's own tests failing on base), paired behaviour differences (each side records calls into changed functions in its own run; `amu/core/sidebyside.py`, `record.py`), and per-hunk evidence states that pick the first line (`amu/core/states.py`, `amu/ci/render.py`). Large suites use a nightly whole-suite recording (`amu-record.yml`, `amu/ci/record_suite.py`); suites that fit the 300 s budget run whole. Current release v0.7.0 (main at PR #99). Evaluation records: `evaluation/STATUS.md`, `evaluation/generalize/REPORT-v070.md` (47-PR set: Django 17, sympy 20, Flask 10, hand labels in `v070-47/labels.json`), `evaluation/pilot/{attrs,httpx,jinja}/REPORT.md` (15 replayed PRs each on forks abslock128w/{attrs,httpx,jinja}, live Action). v0.7.0 numbers: attrs 15/15 first lines, httpx 15/15 (untuned), jinja 13/15 with 121 false rows, Django 14/17 with 24 of 495 raise-catchers missed, sympy 18/20 with 79 of 11,240 missed, 2 false rows on the 47 set. Open PRs #100 (guards never crash), #101 (closure state in input digest), #102 (honest counts; has a merge conflict with main), #103 (mixed hunks, scripts/ excluded, grouped rows) are green on CI and not merged; #99 is merged. A fork abslock128w/requests exists with 15 PRs picked in `requests15.tsv` on branch `eval/v071-tools`, which also holds the evaluation harness scripts (replay, raise_missed.py, freeze). The 47-set local workspace is `~/Documents/ChatGPT/AMU/generalize-2026-11-02` (clones, envs, recordings; rebuild from `evaluation/*/freeze.json` if missing). The owner's standing: AMU is not production-ready until it generalizes; no per-repo tuning, fix causes; losses first; freeze the engine by script before every measurement, never edit engine code while a run is live; each fix is its own PR with a test that fails on the old code; never run an upstream suite without approval (approved: Django, sympy, Flask, Click, Werkzeug, attrs, httpx, jinja, requests); never create new public repositories or touch any upstream project; never commit keys; standing authority to merge own PRs when GitHub CI is green, tag and release, delete own branches; PyPI trusted publisher is not configured (owner task), so releases are GitHub-only. The owner is away: do not stop for questions, record blockers and continue. This checkout is a worktree on branch `docs/status`; make branches from `github/main`, never commit to `docs/status`. Local recording and site-hook tests flake under load; GitHub CI is the arbiter. Run long jobs in the background and keep the laptop usable: at most two measurement streams at a time.

Task:
Three phases. Report after each with numbers first, losses first.

Phase 1, ship v0.7.1. Rebase #102 onto main and resolve its conflict; merge #100, #101, #102, #103 when green. Release v0.7.1 on GitHub (not PyPI). Pin the forks' workflows to v0.7.1 and re-run live: attrs, httpx, jinja (existing fork PRs, re-trigger or new PRs on the existing base branches) and requests (open its 15 PRs from requests15.tsv on the existing fork). Re-run the 47 set locally on the frozen v0.7.1 engine with the raise measure. Targets: Django missed catchers 0 (fix 1 is in), jinja false rows 0, every first line that was wrong at v0.7.0 now right, no regressions. Reports: update evaluation/pilot/*/REPORT.md with before/after, write evaluation/generalize/REPORT-v071.md, evaluation/pilot/requests/REPORT.md.

Phase 2, the regression set. AMU's main signal, a flip, has never fired on a real merged PR in any set (0 flips across 107 PRs), so its true-positive rate is unmeasured. Build evaluation/regressions/: mine the git history of Django, sympy, Flask, attrs, httpx, jinja and requests for merged PRs that introduced a test failure fixed later (signals: a later commit or PR titled "fix regression", "revert", "fixes #N" where N references a bug reported after the PR merged, or a test added later that fails on the PR's head). Verify each candidate by running the later test on the PR's merge base, head, and the fix commit: it must pass, fail, pass. Target 30 confirmed regression PRs across the repos. Then replay each through AMU (local, frozen v0.7.1 engine, same budget as the Action): did AMU post a flip or a behaviour row that names the regressed function? Report: caught / missed per repo, with each miss traced to a cause (test not selected, test not in the suite at that time, flip rejected by trust layer, budget). Do not fix anything in this phase; record causes with reproductions. Write evaluation/regressions/REPORT.md with PROTOCOL.md (how candidates were mined and verified) and labels.json.

Phase 3, measurement trust. Add to evaluation/PROTOCOL.md: (a) a rubric version on every labels.json and every table (start at rubric v3 for the current rules; back-label the v0.6.0 and v0.7.0 tables with their rubric versions); (b) a blind second labeling: write evaluation/blind/ with 20 comments drawn at random from the 47 set and the live sets, with PR ids stripped, and a script that lets a separate session label them without seeing the existing labels; run it yourself in a fresh subagent that is given only the comments and the rubric, and report agreement with the existing labels per field; (c) stability: run 10 of the 47 PRs three times each on the frozen engine and report how many first lines and row counts are identical across trials. Write the numbers into evaluation/STATUS.md with a new section "How much to trust these numbers".

Final message: Phase 1 per-repo table (first line, useful, noise, false rows, missed catchers, suite share), Phase 2 caught/missed table with causes, Phase 3 agreement and stability numbers, then losses, then unfinished and why.

- Fork: abslock128w/attrs. AMU workflows (v0.5.1) on main and on 15 amu-base-<mb10> branches. attrs' own 6 workflows disabled on the fork.
- 15 replay PRs: fork #1-#15 = upstream 1636,1625,1606,1603,1571,1592,1593,1600,1541,1529,1513,1509,1507,1454,1469. Opened 13:49-13:50Z.

- Done 2026-11-02: 15/15 comments posted. Report PR abslock128w/AMU#86 (branch eval/attrs-pilot), merge on green CI.
- Headline: first line 11/15, useful 2, noise 2, 62 false rows (attrs 1509, slotted class gains a slot), 0 false flips; AMU job 34-132 s; open->comment 62-157 s.
- Defect 1 worth following: `from attr import astuple` (package re-export, src layout) not resolved -> TestAsTuple not candidates on attrs 1636.
Finish AMU v0.7.1 in the cloud. Repo abslock128w/AMU, base branch `main`. Run nothing on my laptop.

Rules:
- Never touch upstream repos (psf/requests, pallets/jinja, encode/httpx, python-attrs): no issues, PRs or comments.
- Merging your own PRs on green CI is authorized, and so is deleting their branches.
- Commit trailer: "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>". PR bodies end with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)".
- Git author: abslock128w <rajesh.v@vmrcloudsolutions.com>.
- Never write safe/clean/verified/OK as a verdict.
- Reports put losses first.
- Defects found on untuned repos are recorded, not fixed.
- Never edit engine code during a live run.
- Never commit keys.

1. Get PRs #99–#103 green and merge them one at a time, rebasing the rest; if a test fails, fix it in that PR.
   - #99 `fix/collect-tests`: suite listed by the runner's own collection.
   - #100 `fix/guards-unknown`: guards never crash and never gate a line that ran.
   - #101 `fix/closure-inputs`: closure cells are part of the input.
   - #102 `fix/honest-counts`: "ran N of M" with the reason; "not recorded" after a cut-off run; order-dependent coverage gap; STATUS.md known limit.
   - #103 `fix/mixed-hunks`: block body and runs, `not-production` state for scripts/ and examples/, gate sentence once, grouped behaviour rows.
   - Overlaps: `amu/core/states.py` (#100, #102, #103), `amu/ci/render.py` (#102, #103), `amu/core/__init__.py` (#99, #102).
2. Release v0.7.1.
   - Bump the version.
   - Repin the Action, templates and workflows to v0.7.1, as `evaluation/v071-tools/release070.py` did for 0.7.0.
   - Tag, then create the GitHub release.
   - PyPI publish fails with `invalid-publisher` until I add a trusted publisher. Report it; don't work around it.
3. Re-run the 47 set (Django 17, sympy 20, Flask 10) on v0.7.1, in the cloud or in GitHub Actions.
   - Scripts are on branch `eval/v071-tools`, folder `evaluation/v071-tools/`: `run47.py`, `record47.py`, `gather.py`, `labels47.py`. Adapt the `/Users/...` paths.
   - PR list: `evaluation/performance-v042/freeze.json`.
   - Settings: Python 3.14, 300 s budget per side, 1,200 s wall cap, the raise measure from `evaluation/generalize/raise_missed.py`.
   - Re-make the nightly suite recordings for Django and sympy with `record47.py`: the last commit before 03:23 UTC on the merge base's day, 4 shards.
   - Targets:
     - Django missed raise catchers 0 of 495;
     - first lines right on Django 22204, sympy 30776, Django 22095 and Flask 5812;
     - sympy 30741 reads "not recorded";
     - Django 22158 prints the gate sentence once.
4. Live re-runs with the Action pinned to v0.7.1, using `replay.py` and `collect.py`, on the forks:
   - abslock128w/attrs (`attrs15.tsv`);
   - abslock128w/httpx (`httpx15.tsv`);
   - abslock128w/jinja (`jinja15.tsv`). Targets: 1664 has 0 false rows; 2099 and 2096 first lines right.
5. Eighth, untuned repo: abslock128w/requests. The fork exists and test execution is approved.
   - Use the 15 PRs in `requests15.tsv`.
   - Install line: `python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt`.
   - Same protocol and reports as jinja.
6. Write the reports and open the evaluation PR, then merge it.
   - Reports: `evaluation/generalize/REPORT-v071.md`, `evaluation/pilot/{attrs,httpx,jinja,requests}`.
   - Compare against `evaluation/generalize/REPORT-v070.md`.
7. Final message: a per-repo table (first line right, useful, noise, false rows, missed catchers, suite share), then losses, then unfinished.

Known costs: runner collection takes 16 s on Django and 114 s on sympy per PR job.
